description: This script seeds the database with initial data, including creating an admin user and sample rooms. It uses SQLAlchemy ORM models, environment variables for configuration, and defines functions to insert data if not already present.

classes.name: AdminUser
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing administrator users, with fields like email, password_hash, name, and is_superuser.

classes.name: Room
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing hotel rooms, with fields such as room_number, room_type, price, and is_available.

methods.name: str _hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a given password using bcrypt scheme via passlib context.

methods.name: None seed_admin_user()
methods.description: Creates an admin user in the database if one does not already exist, using environment variables for credentials.

methods.name: None seed_rooms()
methods.description: Adds predefined sample rooms to the database if they are not already present.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Initializes database engine and session, then calls seed functions to populate initial data.
